caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate teapot centered on a plain, off-white background. The teapot is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance and suggesting its three-dimensional form through the use of shading. The body of the teapot is bulbous with gentle curves and horizontal bands, a flared base, and a domed, tiered lid topped with a small, horizontal knob. The handle, located on the right, is large, ornate, and angular with multiple curves, while the spout on the left is elongated with a wide tip that curves upward. The drawing is enclosed within a rectangular border, and the name "ROBERT BRIGADIER" appears in capital letters at the bottom right corner of the bordered area.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
